name: Vengeful Quickdraw
description: Rest the pistol on the sight line and hold the hawk's stare on one chosen mark.

name: Verity Muzzle
description: Close the fingers in a talon grip and feel the pistol's weight settle as though perched.

name: Wrathful Frizzen
description: Draw in a single downward wingbeat of the arm, the barrel rising to the mark at its end.

name: Equipoise Hammer
description: Hold the barrel along the forearm like a cliff's edge and let a falling blade slide off.

name: Lanyardring Vortex
description: Keep the weight light on both feet like a hovering hawk and shift in any direction.

name: Gust Thumbback
description: Hold the sight on the foe from above his eye line, then let the shot fall along the stoop.

name: Pistolvigil
description: Draw qi up the spine so the arm floats steady, like a bird riding warm air.

name: Hammerdurance
description: Circle the foe at a slow walk with the barrel orbiting him, so every guard he sets is turned.

name: Punishing Barrel
description: Fire from a dropping crouch with qi packed into the ball so it pierces armor along the fall line.

name: Lotmuzzle
description: Rake the pistol butt across the foe's guard like a talon, then fire into the opened side.

name: Berserk Flashpan
description: Fix the hawk's unwavering stare on the foe and hold qi in the bore until the single shot lands where the stare rests.

name: Meteoric Snapfire
description: Place each step on the flat top of an imagined ford stone, steady and unhurried.

name: Evergreen Cylinder
description: Drop into a crouch among the reeds so only the pistol and the eyes show above the bank.

name: Beneficent Triggerbar
description: Read the foe's weight shifts as ripples crossing still water and aim at where the next one will land.

name: Rumble Foresight
description: Lay the barrel on the muddy lip of the bank and take one slow shot at the far side.

name: Chimemuzzle
description: Skim a ball low along the line of the foe's advance like a stone across water.

name: Gustreport
description: Draw the foe's rush past by stepping back as an undertow tugs at his stride.

name: Mayhemreport
description: Fire at a pool's edge to throw spray and smoke together as a veil across the foe's eyes.

name: Ponderous Pistolgrip
description: Hold back shot after shot behind a single line of qi, like water behind a weir, then release them together.

name: Slag Barrel
description: Turn the barrel in a slow spiral and loose balls that circle inward upon a cluster of foes.

name: Hourpistol
description: Gather one long breath at the source, then carry a single sweeping line of shots across the field and into the foe's rear.

name: Rumble Report
description: Measure the charge by feel in the palm and pour it with the same breath that steadies the arm.

name: Rumble Triggerbar
description: Count three beats while priming the pan so each load takes an unvarying time.

name: Barrelflash
description: Slide sideways in a line parallel to the foe so the barrel never changes its bearing on him.

name: Equipoise Pistolgrip
description: Raise the stoppered powder horn on its cord to catch a thrown knife or short cut.

name: Flashpan Insight
description: Breathe in with the left track and out with the right, tuning the shot's pulse to the lungs.

name: Reporthavoc
description: Weigh the powder charge against a measured thread of qi so push and pulse arrive in balance.

name: Chime Pointblank
description: Let the two tracks meet at the instant the hammer falls so the spark and the qi pulse coincide.

name: Mayhemhammer
description: Point the barrel one way while the wrist turns the true line the other, breaking the foe's guess.

name: Foresight Mettle
description: Blow qi along the smoke so it drifts in a second track and hides the shooter's real position.

name: Hipshot Havoc
description: Fire along both tracks at once so the powder's drive and the qi's drill bore through the same point.

name: Ghosting Hammer
description: Step through the flash of the shot into the space the foe leaves empty as he flinches back.

name: Intent Report
description: Weave powder shots and qi pulses in alternate beats until the foe cannot tell which will strike.

name: Glint Quickdraw
description: Fire along hand and qi in one instant so the powder's push and the qi's pull land as a single blow.

name: Hammerglimmer
description: Hold the two hands at matching heights with the feet square so each can cover the other.

name: Glintpistol
description: Let the free left hand rise to shield the face as the right draws and fires.

name: Unsparing Frizzen
description: Anchor the right elbow at the ribs and fire from the braced arm at close quarters.

name: Wrathful Thumbback
description: Ram the ball with one hand while the other holds the pistol, passing the load between them smoothly.

name: Gust Cylinder
description: Cross the wrists so the barrels form an X that catches a downward blade.

name: Shademuzzle
description: Fire in alternate turn from two pistols across the foe's front to keep his head low.

name: Harnessing Hipshot
description: Move the two arms as mirror images so the foe reads the false hand as the true one.

name: Hellish Pointblank
description: Bring both pistols together at the foe's centre and fire in one report through the opened guard.

name: Shadepistol
description: Gather qi evenly in both hands, then spread a settled curtain of shots that pins every foe in front.

name: Chime Pistolgrip
description: Match breath to the slow rhythm of the lock, feeling powder and qi sit in balance.

name: Torrential Lanyardring
description: Walk the long hall with the pistol in a sleeve and draw it only on the last stride.

name: Gust Hipshot
description: Slide the pistol from a wide sleeve in the instant of a formal bow and level it.

name: Nova Quickdraw
description: Lift the barrel from below the lowered head so the foe sees only courtesy until the shot.

name: Torrent Hammer
description: Fold the arm across the body in a gesture of respect that turns aside a stabbing hand.

name: Eviscerating Lanyardring
description: Dust each grain of powder with qi as it falls so the whole charge burns in one clean flash.

name: Flashpan Havoc
description: Let qi flow into the powder as the hammer falls and back into the arm as the recoil returns.

name: Mayhem Cylinder
description: Let the pale smoke drift into a veil and step behind it as the foe peers through.

name: Charter Triggerbar
description: Hush the report with a muffling pulse of qi so the shot sounds as a distant knock.

name: Tempered Muzzle
description: Fire both locks in the same breath so two qi-wrapped balls strike one armored point.

name: Granite Frizzen
description: Ignite a gathered charge and let the burst carry fragments of shot out across a group of foes.

name: Hour Foresight
description: Run one unbroken course of powder shots and qi pulses, each flowing into the next without a seam.

name: Muzzleflash
description: Drop into a coiled crouch with the weight forward, ready to launch into a rush.

name: Verity Barrel
description: Trail the free arm back like a tail feather and feel the balance of the whole body.

name: Merciless Pointblank
description: Draw the pistol along the downward line of a dive and fire at its lowest point.

name: Iron Barrel
description: Sweep the cloak or sleeve wide in a downward beat to shield the body from a foe's cut.

name: Silt Snapfire
description: Plunge forward in a single long step that closes the gap before the foe can reset.

name: Reportruin
description: Fire at the foot of the dive, as the body levels out, and skim the ball low across the ground.

name: Immobilizing Frizzen
description: Fire as a sharp qi cry rings out, so shot and shout break the foe's focus together.

name: Hammerruin
description: Fire two qi-wrapped balls in a steep falling line to pierce the foe's raised guard.

name: Tempered Thumbback
description: Swoop beyond the foe's guard, rake the pistol butt along his arm and fire from the opened flank.

name: Pointblank Glimmer
description: Flash from far off to the foe's flank in one dive and fire as he turns to meet it.

name: Booming Muzzle
description: Ease the hammer down to the pan with a thumb so no click betrays the readied shot.

name: Remnant Muzzle
description: Breathe slowly in the still air and feel every pulse and tremor in the body quiet.

name: Granite Snapfire
description: Walk heel to toe in soft boots so the steps vanish into the quiet.

name: Granite Foresight
description: Wrap the barrel in cloth to hold off a blade without the ring of steel on steel.

name: Glintbarrel
description: Draw the pistol with held breath and no whisper of leather, firing at the end of the stillness.

name: Murkhammer
description: Fire toward a rock face so the echo rolls round the basin and the foe turns toward it.

name: Chime Hipshot
description: Hold utterly still with the shot gathered in the bore until the foe's attention slips.

name: Nova Snapfire
description: Smother the pan's flash under a cupped palm so the priming lights without a visible spark.

name: Devastating Hammer
description: After long stillness, break it with one qi-wrapped shot that pierces cover and guard together.

name: Granite Pistolgrip
description: Fire soft, spaced shots round the foe's cover until he dares not raise his head.

name: Mastering Cylinder
description: Gather the basin's stillness about the foe so every move he makes is checked and one shot lands unheard.
